items.title: Henry "Booker T." Glass Interview, 1962-03-22
items.q: You know Wilbur Tillman? Did you ever play with him?

ctx.x: That's why we named them to chamella band because I was carrying the chamella band after johnny I was carrying the Camellia Band, the orchestra. Garnier was carrying the brass band, Camellia Band, you understand? We made it go to Camellia.
You know Wilbur Tillman? Did you ever play with him?
Tillman, yeah, I played with Tillman.
